Get P. LEAGUE+ Player Box Score

Source: R/pleague.R
pleague_box_players.Rd

Player box score of one finished game: minutes, points, shooting splits, rebounds, assists, plus/minus, and the ratings from 2022-23; did-not-play rows included.

Endpoint: GET https://pleagueofficial.com/api/boxscore.preciser.php?id={gid}&away_tab=total&home_tab=total (after the game page)

Usage

pleague_box_players(gid)

Arguments

gid

Required. P. LEAGUE+ game id on the site: ONE global integer sequence over every stage and season (197 = the 2022-23 opener, 662 = the 2025-26 opener), e.g. 197; gid in pleague_schedule. Only finished games are served.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: Player box score of one finished game: minutes, points, shooting splits, rebounds, assists, plus/minus, and the ratings from 2022-23; did-not-play rows included. An empty valid answer is a zero-row tibble with these columns, in this order (sportsdataverse-py pleague_box_players):

col_nametypedescription
gidintegerP. LEAGUE+ game id on the site: ONE global integer sequence over every stage and season (1-12 = 2020-21 pre-season, 13 = the 2020-21 opener, 197 = the 2022-23 opener, 662 = the 2025-26 opener), with gaps; a row id, not a count. The {gid} of /game/{gid}.
sidecharacterWhich team the row belongs to: home or away. The box lists home first, the play-by-play and the schedule list away first.
player_idintegerP. LEAGUE+ player-team membership id on the site (key space: the member id the player page passes to trackPlayer(), e.g. 40 = Lai Ting-En), cast to an integer. NOT the 8-character page id. Join box rows on it, never on the printed name.
person_idcharacterPreciser person uuid (key space: the analytics vendor's persons): the join between a box row and a pleague_preciser_shots row. Present on played rows from 2022-23; null on 2020-21 and 2021-22 rows and did-not-play rows (the refs notes report some 2025-26 finals boxes without it; gid 716 has it).
random_idcharacterThe 8-character page id of /player/{id} (same space as player_page_id). Reliable from 2022-23 only: on 2020-21 and 2021-22 rows it is wrong for most players (gid 13 gives Lai Ting-En the page of Kao Kuo-Hao), so never join across eras on it.
name_zhcharacterPlayer name as printed (Traditional Chinese, or a transliteration for foreign players).
jerseycharacterShirt number as printed, a string ('0', '00' and '10' differ).
starterlogicalTrue for a starter (the site's '(Chinese text)' marker). Null on did-not-play rows.
playedlogicalTrue when the player has court time; false on a 'DNP' (did not play) row, whose statistics are null.
minutescharacterMinutes played 'mm:ss'. Null on did-not-play rows.
secondsintegerPlaying time in whole seconds: the site's seconds column in 2020-21 and 2021-22, derived from minutes from 2022-23. Null on did-not-play rows.
pointsintegerPoints scored. Null on did-not-play rows.
reb_offintegerOffensive rebounds. Null on did-not-play rows.
reb_defintegerDefensive rebounds. Null on did-not-play rows.
rebintegerTotal rebounds (offensive plus defensive). Null on did-not-play rows.
astintegerAssists. Null on did-not-play rows.
stlintegerSteals. Null on did-not-play rows.
blkintegerBlocks made. Null on did-not-play rows.
tovintegerTurnovers committed. Null on did-not-play rows.
pfintegerPersonal fouls committed. Null on did-not-play rows.
plus_minusintegerPlus/minus: the team's points minus the opponent's while the player was on court (signed). Null on did-not-play rows.
effintegerEfficiency: points + rebounds + assists + steals + blocks - missed field goals - missed free throws - turnovers (verified on every 2020-21 and 2021-22 row). Null on did-not-play rows.
fg2_madeinteger2-point field goals made, from the site's 'made-attempted' string. Null on did-not-play rows.
fg2_attinteger2-point field goals attempted, from the site's 'made-attempted' string. Null on did-not-play rows.
fg2_pctdouble2-point field-goal percentage, 0-100 (the site sends a number or a string). Null on did-not-play rows.
fg3_madeinteger3-point field goals made, from the site's 'made-attempted' string. Null on did-not-play rows.
fg3_attinteger3-point field goals attempted, from the site's 'made-attempted' string. Null on did-not-play rows.
fg3_pctdouble3-point field-goal percentage, 0-100. Null on did-not-play rows.
ft_madeintegerFree throws made, from the site's 'made-attempted' string. Null on did-not-play rows.
ft_attintegerFree throws attempted, from the site's 'made-attempted' string. Null on did-not-play rows.
ft_pctdoubleFree-throw percentage, 0-100. Null on did-not-play rows.
efg_pctdoubleEffective field-goal percentage 0-100, (FGM + 0.5 x 3PM) / FGA x 100 (verified). 2020-21 and 2021-22 rows only; null from 2022-23.
ts_pctdoubleTrue-shooting percentage 0-100, PTS / (2 x (FGA + 0.44 x FTA)) x 100 (verified). 2020-21 and 2021-22 rows only; null from 2022-23.
usage_pctdoubleUsage percentage as the site prints it, 0-100; the standard usage formula reproduces it on only 685 of 3,932 rows, so the formula is unverified. 2020-21 and 2021-22 rows only.
positioncharacterPosition code on some 2020-21 and 2021-22 rows ('G' guard, 'F' forward, 'C' centre); null on the rest and from 2022-23.
ortgdoubleOffensive rating: the team's points scored per 100 offensive possessions while the player was on court (2022-23 on; null before). Null on did-not-play rows.
drtgdoubleDefensive rating: the opponent's points per 100 of its possessions while the player was on court, lower is better (2022-23 on). Null on did-not-play rows.
netrtgdoubleNet rating, ortg minus drtg (exact on every checked row; 2022-23 on). Null on did-not-play rows.
pacedoublePace: 48 x the team's offensive possessions / minutes on court, the team's possessions per 48 minutes with this player on court (verified on 1,124 of 1,149 rows; 2022-23 on). Null on did-not-play rows.
ast_ratiodoubleAssist ratio 0-100: assists per 100 of the player's own plays. The common formula AST / (FGA + 0.5 x FTA + AST + TOV) reproduces it on 919 of 1,174 rows, so the exact formula is unverified (2022-23 on).
to_ratiodoubleTurnover ratio 0-100: turnovers per 100 of the player's own plays; same unverified formula family as ast_ratio (917 of 1,174 rows; 2022-23 on).
off_possessionsintegerThe team's offensive possessions while the player was on court (the base of ortg; 2022-23 on). Null on did-not-play rows.
opp_off_possessionsintegerThe opponent's offensive possessions while the player was on court (the base of drtg; 2022-23 on). Null on did-not-play rows.
opp_pts_second_chanceintegerOpponent second-chance points while the player was on court (2022-23 on). Null on did-not-play rows.
opp_pts_fast_breakintegerOpponent fast-break points while the player was on court (2022-23 on). Null on did-not-play rows.
opp_pts_off_turnoverintegerOpponent points off turnovers while the player was on court (2022-23 on). Null on did-not-play rows.
opp_pts_paintintegerOpponent points in the paint while the player was on court (2022-23 on). Null on did-not-play rows.

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in pleague_schedule().
